❄️ Smart & Powerful Cooling

GREE Shimo Series provides fast and stable cooling performance with advanced inverter technology and intelligent temperature control. The AC can quickly cool rooms while reducing electricity consumption.

name: GREE Airy Split Air Conditioner Inverter (1.0 TON)
short_desc:
GREE Wall Type Air Conditioner

Model: GS-12XARV32 PRO (Inverter)

Capacity: 1.0 TON
long_desc:
1. Performance & Compressor Technology

G-Boost Inverter Compressor: Built around a heavy-duty T3 Tropical Compressor, this unit is engineered specifically for extreme climates. It uses G-Boost technology to prevent "thermal throttling," ensuring the AC provides stable, consistent cooling even when outdoor ambient temperatures reach up to 68°C.

Ultra-Wide Voltage Operation (130V – 275V): The internal electronics are designed to absorb and stabilize volatile power fluctuations without requiring an external voltage stabilizer. This keeps the compressor running safely during deep voltage sags or sudden spikes.

Eco-Friendly R32 Refrigerant: Utilizes low-GWP (Global Warming Potential) R32 refrigerant, which delivers higher thermodynamic efficiency and reduced energy consumption compared to older refrigerants.

 

2. Artificial Intelligence & Smart Integration

G-Learning Algorithm: Driven by a dedicated onboard AI chip, the AC actively tracks and learns your local environment, ambient humidity, and routine usage habits. It optimizes its inverter control scheme dynamically, reducing annual power consumption by up to 10% to 20% compared to standard inverter units.

Dual Connectivity (Wi-Fi + Bluetooth): Seamlessly pairs with smart devices via Bluetooth for instant setup and offers full Wi-Fi control for remote access, Scheduling, and voice control compatibility (Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa).

 

3. Comprehensive 6-Stage Air Purification

The Airy series emphasizes indoor air quality (IAQ) through a specialized multi-tier filtration and sterilization pathway:

Stage 1 & 2 (Physical Filtration): High-density inlet air filtration to trap large airborne particles, pollen, and dust. Designed for easy removal and cleaning.

Stage 3 (Air Inlet UVC Sterilization): A built-in UV-C light emitter sanitizes incoming air, neutralizing bacteria and viruses right at the intake stage.

Stage 4 (Deep Evaporator Cleaning): Periodically runs an automated defrosting, frosting, and high-temperature drying cycle to wash away hidden mold and grime from the internal evaporator.

Stage 5 (Cold Plasma Air Outlet Purification): Generates specialized ions at the air discharge point to actively break down surface pathogens and eliminate stubborn odors.

Stage 6 (Outdoor Unit Self-Cleaning): Reverses the fan or utilizes targeted cycles on the outdoor unit (ODU) to clear dust and debris away from the condenser fins, preserving optimal heat exchange over time.

 

4. Airflow & Comfort Design

Independent Smart Dehumidification: Monitors room climate metrics to maintain a personalized humidity level (adjustable between 30% and 80%). This provides a crisp, comfortable indoor feel without overcooling the space or drying out your skin.

4-Way Long-Distance Air Throw: Delivers an expansive airflow pattern with an effective air throw distance of up to 15.5 meters, ensuring uniform temperature distribution across large or deep rooms.

Ultra-Quiet Performance: Features modified internal aerodynamics that drop the lowest operational fan speed sound pressure levels down to a whisper-quiet 19 dB to 25 dB.

Closed Dustproof Chassis: The physical frame features a sleek, tight-sealing front panel mechanism that completely closes when shut down, preventing settling dust and insects from entering the internal assembly.

Key Features Breakdown

 1. Smart AI & Efficiency Technology

  • G-AI Technology: An intelligent algorithm that dynamically learns user habits and monitors ambient temperature, room size, and humidity. It alters its operation strategy to maintain maximum comfort while saving up to 10% of energy consumption annually. 

 

  • Inverter Pro Technology: High-efficiency dual rotary inverter system ensures rapid cooling/heating with smooth, stable temperature control, reducing overall electricity draws significantly. 

 

  • Eco Mode & Low Watt Start: Optimizes performance for energy conservation and allows stable startup even under voltage fluctuations (Ultra-Wide Voltage Operation: roughly 165V–265V). 

 

2. Comfort & Airflow Control

  • 7 Fan Speeds: Offers highly customizable airflow rates (from subtle, quiet breezes to powerful high-volume circulation). 

 

  • 2-Way / 4-Way Auto Swing: Distributes conditioned air evenly into every corner of the room to eliminate hotspots. 

 

  • Smart Humidity Control: Includes a continuous dehumidification function designed to comfortably adjust room moisture curves, which can even assist with tasks like indoor clothes drying. 

 

  • I-Feel Feature: A sensor embedded in the remote control measures the ambient temperature exactly where you are sitting, adjusting the unit's output to match your immediate location. 

 

  • Ultra-Quiet Mode: Lowers operational decibel levels significantly for a peaceful sleep or work environment.

  • 4-Step Indoor Unit (IDU) Self-Cleaning: Runs through a thorough internal maintenance process to keep the air pure: 
    1. Dust Removal 
    2. Condensation
    3. Frosting
    4. Defrosting

 

  • Outdoor Unit (ODU) Self-Cleaning: Removes accumulated outdoor dust and moisture automatically to maintain system performance over time. 

 

  • UVC Pro Sterilization / Cold Plasma: Continuously irradiates the evaporator and internal airflow to neutralize bacteria, mold spores, and viruses before the air is circulated back into the room.

  • Built-in Wi-Fi Control: Seamlessly connects to smartphones via a dedicated app for complete remote control, scheduling, and smart home eco-system pairing. 

 

  • Hidden LED Display: Sleek, modern display layout on the indoor chassis with brightness controls so it won't disrupt you at night.

  • Capacity Variants: Available in 1.0 Ton (12,000 BTU), 1.5 Ton (18,000 BTU), and 2.0 Ton (24,000 BTU) variants.

name: GREE CLIVIA Split Air Conditioner Inverter (2.0 TON)
short_desc:
GREE Wall Type Air Conditioner

Model: GSH-24XCLV32 (Inverter)

Capacity: 2.0 TON (Hot & Cool)
long_desc:
The GREE Clivia Split Series is a premium line of smart inverter air conditioners (typically offering both Hot & Cool functionality). Its defining characteristic is being the world’s first residential AC series integrated with G-AI (Artificial Intelligence) to optimize energy consumption based on user behavior and environmental factors. 

 

Key Features Breakdown

 1. Smart AI & Efficiency Technology

  • G-AI Technology: An intelligent algorithm that dynamically learns user habits and monitors ambient temperature, room size, and humidity. It alters its operation strategy to maintain maximum comfort while saving up to 10% of energy consumption annually. 

 

  • Inverter Pro Technology: High-efficiency dual rotary inverter system ensures rapid cooling/heating with smooth, stable temperature control, reducing overall electricity draws significantly. 

 

  • Eco Mode & Low Watt Start: Optimizes performance for energy conservation and allows stable startup even under voltage fluctuations (Ultra-Wide Voltage Operation: roughly 165V–265V). 

 

2. Comfort & Airflow Control

  • 7 Fan Speeds: Offers highly customizable airflow rates (from subtle, quiet breezes to powerful high-volume circulation). 

 

  • 2-Way / 4-Way Auto Swing: Distributes conditioned air evenly into every corner of the room to eliminate hotspots. 

 

  • Smart Humidity Control: Includes a continuous dehumidification function designed to comfortably adjust room moisture curves, which can even assist with tasks like indoor clothes drying. 

 

  • I-Feel Feature: A sensor embedded in the remote control measures the ambient temperature exactly where you are sitting, adjusting the unit's output to match your immediate location. 

 

  • Ultra-Quiet Mode: Lowers operational decibel levels significantly for a peaceful sleep or work environment. 

 

3. Cleanliness & Health Tech

  • 4-Step Indoor Unit (IDU) Self-Cleaning: Runs through a thorough internal maintenance process to keep the air pure: 
    1. Dust Removal 
    2. Condensation
    3. Frosting
    4. Defrosting

 

  • Outdoor Unit (ODU) Self-Cleaning: Removes accumulated outdoor dust and moisture automatically to maintain system performance over time. 

 

  • UVC Pro Sterilization / Cold Plasma: Continuously irradiates the evaporator and internal airflow to neutralize bacteria, mold spores, and viruses before the air is circulated back into the room. 

 

4. Connectivity & Maintenance

  • Built-in Wi-Fi Control: Seamlessly connects to smartphones via a dedicated app for complete remote control, scheduling, and smart home eco-system pairing. 

 

  • Hidden LED Display: Sleek, modern display layout on the indoor chassis with brightness controls so it won't disrupt you at night. 

 

  • Comprehensive Anti-Corrosion Protection: Utilizes Golden Fin / 100% copper condensers designed to withstand harsh outdoor weathering and prevent early rusting, significantly increasing the unit's lifespan. 

 

5. General Technical Overview

  • Capacity Variants: Available in 1.0 Ton (12,000 BTU), 1.5 Ton (18,000 BTU), and 2.0 Ton (24,000 BTU) variants.

 

  • Refrigerant: Eco-friendly, low global warming potential R32 gas. 

 

  • Turbo Cooling: Features a 60-second quick cooling/heating boost when you first power on the machine.

functionality.functionality_text: LED Display provides a clear and easy-to-read indication of temperature, operating mode, timer settings, and system status, allowing convenient monitoring and control of the air conditioner at a glance

functionality.title: R410A Refrigerant
